view_frame: The drawing presents a single side silhouette view. The vertical axis represents height (Z) and the horizontal axis represents width (X). The object is axisymmetric about the vertical Z-axis. The base of the vase is located at Z=0.

features.axis_or_plane: XZ plane revolved about Z axis
features.placement: Revolve the profile 360 degrees about the Z axis. The profile is defined by vertices (radius, height) in the XZ plane. The profile is a closed loop representing a hollow vessel with a recessed interior. Outer profile points (approximate): (0,0) -> (25,0) -> (35,10) -> (40,30) -> (30,60) -> (15,80) -> (15,110) -> (18,120) -> (0,120). Inner profile points (offset by wall/floor thickness): (0,4) -> (21,4) -> (31,14) -> (36,30) -> (26,60) -> (11,80) -> (11,110) -> (14,116) -> (0,116). The recess depth of 116mm implies the interior floor is at Z=4mm (120-116=4).
features.evidence: Single continuous outline resembling a Greek vase. Clarification answer specifies 'recess' with depth 116mm.

connections: The outer and inner profiles form a single closed loop for the revolve operation.
The recess depth determines the Z-height of the inner floor.
edit_rules: Changing the max dimension (height) scales the Z coordinates of all vertices.
Changing the max radius scales the X coordinates of the widest points.
Changing wall/floor thickness adjusts the offset of the inner profile from the outer profile.
Changing recess depth adjusts the Z coordinate of the inner floor vertices.
unresolved: Exact coordinates for the curved silhouette are approximated from the image proportions.
Wall and floor thickness are assumed values as they are not explicitly dimensioned.
